We believe in the timelessness of hospitality. We exist to champion the enduring spirit of hospitality—innovating with purpose to meet the evolving needs of our guests while holding fast to the timeless principles of care and warmth.
A familiar stay for the individual that revels in the simplicity of meaningful touches and a personalized service.

Guests: A familiar stay for the individual that revels in the simplicity of meaningful touches and a personalized service.

Owners: Benefit from the reincarnation of the iconic hotel brand with global recognition, designed for universal appeal across markets.

Choice: A distinct yet highly scalable brand, prime for conversions, that appeals to upscale consumers.

Beacon of Hospitality: Rekindling Upscale with heritage charm and timeless service, injecting soul back into every stay.

Experience — Charming simplicity: Signature elements stand as the cornerstone of a personal atmosphere; every detail contributes to enhancing each stay—from elevated amenities to personalized service—creating a consistently unique experience centered on what truly matters.

Design — Contemporary classic: Hotels are rooted in American style and sensibility, reimagining classic hotel features with stylish and modern accents to curate an environment that feels intimately familiar.

Service — Gracious hospitality: Committed to creating a welcoming atmosphere that feels both distinguished and accessible; our team embodies the mindset of a trusted bartender—combining the best of traditional hospitality with the intuitive understanding of each guest's needs.

Charming simplicity — signature elements and a personal atmosphere; elevated amenities and personalized service centered on what truly matters.

Contemporary classic — American style and sensibility; classic features with subtle nostalgia and modern accents; intimately familiar.

Gracious hospitality — welcoming, distinguished yet accessible; trusted-bartender mindset; traditional hospitality with intuitive understanding of guest needs.
Hotels today feel impersonal and standardized. Guests appreciate the efficiency of modern accommodations but long for the authenticity and genuineness of a bygone era of travel.
